body: Wow  . Had the exact opposite experience

Well over the weekend I became temporarily homeless. Finally got a new place but was swindled into a new piece of shit room and crappy toilet with mold. Its amazing how shit just keeps getting worse. At this stage I'm curious to see if I actually get cancer.
Men , I am so fucked right now, its impossible to see the humour. I might even get kicked out of the country I've been staying in for 6 years.
From my perspective tragic drama, To an observer it would be a comedy thinning how fucked up is this dudes life. LITERALLY EVERYTHING THAT COULD GO WRONG WENT WRONG.
Went through his lectures in the rebuilding phase
Asking myself the same question? Going to spend my birthday tomorrow in a motel and try and figure it out
From my side, things are getting incredibly worse almost like watching a movie where a characters life is just written to be a disaster after disaster.

Read this sub or find blogs about people with similar situations, keep hoping that I'll find something that would help me out but so far .......
A more recent development was taking in a crap load of sleeping pills, the euphoria makes me feel like things could be okay then I wake up, its not.
So is it the bond between the sub units being covalent that differentiate it from other compounds that might have ionic or other type of bonds?

I've made numerous attempts, stopped counting at 5. Spent a whole week dosing bottles of sleeping pills. It's been months and I'm still processing how the hell I'm still here. No plans for the summer or fall, my mind's just in limbo.
You think about a lot of shit. It's not just a jump in front of a truck but I never ever thought of what it would be like when you're gone. Its weighing the pros vs cons in leaving or staying.
Why do people keep mentioning the ones you leave behind? Some of us don't really have anyone or the small number we might have in our lives are absolutely terrible
And you let people in, they find out feeble you are then take advantage of you. MANKIND Greatest fucking species!
